summary: 一种短效欣快性兴奋剂，作为 MDMA 类似物开发，在被禁前在研究化学品圈极为流行。街头市场常见，但线上较少。强烈的强迫性补服冲动。
effectsSummary: Mephedrone has stimulating and empathogenic effects. Euphoria, increased sociability, enhanced sensory perception, increased libido, jaw clenching.
generalRisks: Increased heart rate and blood pressure, sweating, jaw clenching, insomnia. Potential for serotonin syndrome. Nasal irritation when snorted.
saferUse: 使用后可能会有情绪低落期。
避免与其他兴奋剂同用。
